title: Starter: LED with current-limiting resistor
manual_page: Guided project: LED with current-limiting resistor
finish: Both parts are placed. Wire +5 V to the resistor, resistor to the LED long leg, LED short leg to ground, then power on.

steps.instruction: Place the breadboard flat in front of the camera.
Place one 330 ohm resistor (orange, orange, brown) on the left half of the board.

expect.label: resistor
expect.zone_hint: Move the resistor to the left half of the board.

steps.tip: Orange, orange, brown, gold is 330 ohm.

steps.instruction: Place the LED on the right half, close to the resistor. Long leg toward the resistor.

expect.label: led
expect.zone_hint: Move the LED to the right half of the board.

steps.tip: The long leg is the anode (+). The flat edge of the rim marks the cathode.
